description: This file defines a factory function to create CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) controllers for Mongoose models with tenant enforcement, validation, caching, and error handling. It handles list retrievals with pagination, sorting, filtering, and includes utility functions for sanitizing input and managing tenant filters.

methods.name: validateSort(sort, allowed = ['timestamp', 'created_at', '_id'])
methods.description: Validates and sanitizes the sort string against allowed fields, supporting descending/sorting prefix '-' and providing a default fallback.

methods.name: clampLimit(limit, max = 500)
methods.description: Enforces a maximum limit on page size for pagination, ensuring it's within safe bounds.

methods.name: microGet(key)
methods.description: Retrieves a cached response payload from the in-memory micro-cache if not expired.

methods.name: microSet(key, payload)
methods.description: Stores a response payload in the micro-cache with a TTL (Time To Live).

methods.name: buildListKey(req, filter, sort, page, limit, skip, explicit)
methods.description: Constructs a unique cache key based on request parameters and query to memoize list responses.

methods.name: sanitizePayloadWithTenant(req)
methods.description: Cleanses the request payload to remove client-supplied tenant identifiers and injects the tenantId from request context unless bypassed.

methods.name: mergeFilterWithTenant(filter, tenantId)
methods.description: Merges a provided filter with enforced tenant filters, ignoring client-provided tenant hints and ensuring multi-field tenant matching.

methods.name: buildCrudController(Model, listDefaultSort = '-timestamp')
methods.description: Main factory function that builds a complete set of CRUD API handlers for a Mongoose model with tenant isolation, filtering, sorting, caching, error mapping, and pagination.
